name: guto-skills
description: Human-audited orchestration skills for plan, build, verify, and review with conditional Agent Skills routing.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, and review without a rigid all-in-one council.
interface.longDescription: Guto Skills provides four explicit orchestration stages. Each stage selects only the applicable Agent Skills, persists the approved plan and checklist, and stops for human audit before the next stage.
defaultPrompt: Use guto-plan to consolidate this task before implementation
Use guto-build to execute the approved plan and stop before verification
Use guto-verify to prove the acceptance criteria
Use guto-review to decide whether the verified change is merge-ready
